title: Pant Wildlife Sanctuary
tagline: Pant Wildlife Sanctuary — The Five Sacred Hills of Rajgir & Historic Peace Pagoda

heroImage.alt: Pant Wildlife Sanctuary - Situauted in Sasaram, Bihar. Accessible easily via rail and road.

overview.short: Pant Wildlife Sanctuary in Rajgir covers 35.8 square kilometers across the historic five hills (Vipulagiri, Ratnagiri, Gridhrakuta, Udaygiri, and Sona Giri), rich in ancient Buddhist and Jain lore.
overview.description: Cradled in a green valley encircled by the ancient 40-kilometer Cyclopean Stone Wall, Pant Sanctuary preserves dry deciduous forests sheltering leopards, nilgai, hyenas, and rich birdlife. Perched atop the hills are the world-famous Vishwa Shanti Stupa, Vulture Peak (Gridhrakuta) where Lord Buddha delivered the Lotus Sutra, and the Swarna Bhandar caves.
overview.about: A historic landscape where ancient mountain citadels, serene stupas, hot springs, and forested hills create an unforgettable experience.

howToReach.roadNote: Connected via NH-120 and Bakhtiyarpur-Rajgir 4-lane highway from Patna and Gaya.

topPlaces.name: Vishwa Shanti Stupa & Ratnagiri Hilltop
topPlaces.description: Dazzling white marble Peace Pagoda erected in 1969 by Nichidatsu Fuji Guruji atop Ratnagiri Hill.

image.alt: Vishwa Shanti Stupa & Ratnagiri Hilltop in Pant Wildlife Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Gridhrakuta Peak (Vulture Peak Meditation Site)
topPlaces.description: Sacred natural rock ledge where Lord Buddha spent many rainy seasons preaching the Lotus Sutra.

image.alt: Gridhrakuta Peak (Vulture Peak Meditation Site) in Pant Wildlife Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Rajgir Aerial Ropeway & Chairlift
topPlaces.description: India’s oldest operating single-chair scenic ropeway gliding across lush forested hill slopes.

image.alt: Rajgir Aerial Ropeway & Chairlift in Pant Wildlife Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Swarna Bhandar (Treasury Caves of Bimbisara)
topPlaces.description: 3rd-century BCE polished rock-cut caves believed to house the unrecovered treasury of King Bimbisara.

image.alt: Swarna Bhandar (Treasury Caves of Bimbisara) in Pant Wildlife Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Cyclopean Wall of Rajgir (40-km Stone Rampart)
topPlaces.description: Pre-Mauryan 2,500-year-old monumental raw stone rampart that encircled the ancient capital of Magadh.

image.alt: Cyclopean Wall of Rajgir (40-km Stone Rampart) in Pant Wildlife Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Bimbisara Jail & Maniyar Math Ruins
topPlaces.description: Historic stone enclosure where Prince Ajatashatru imprisoned his father King Bimbisara.

image.alt: Bimbisara Jail & Maniyar Math Ruins in Pant Wildlife Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Venuvana (Bamboo Grove Monastery of Buddha)
topPlaces.description: Historic peaceful bamboo park and pond donated by King Bimbisara for Buddha and the Sangha.

image.alt: Venuvana (Bamboo Grove Monastery of Buddha) in Pant Wildlife Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Saptaparni Cave (First Buddhist Council Site)
topPlaces.description: Sacred cave atop Vaibhara Hill where 500 Arhats convened the First Buddhist Council in 483 BCE.

image.alt: Saptaparni Cave (First Buddhist Council Site) in Pant Wildlife Sanctuary, Bihar
